name: agent-email-inbox
title_zh: 收信就动手之前，先过一遍发件人白名单
tagline_zh: 让邮件触发 Agent 干活，最怕的是陌生人一封信就把你的工具链调走。它把发件人白名单、内容过滤、注入防护先摆好。
tagline_en: Let email trigger your agent without letting strangers drive it. Sender allowlists, content filtering and.
desc_en: Use when building any system where email content triggers actions — AI agent inboxes, automated support handlers, email-to-task pipelines, or any workflow processing untrusted inbound email. Always use this skill when the user wants to receive emails and act on them programmatically, even if they don't mention "agent" — the skill contains critical security patterns (sender allowlists, content filt
why_zh: 它把入站邮件当不可信输入处理：先验发件人、再滤内容、最后才允许触发动作，顺序不颠倒。
why_en: Treats inbound mail as untrusted input: verify sender, filter content, only then allow an action. The order never flips.
limit_zh: 只覆盖「邮件进来触发动作」这一段，发信、模板、投递率都不管；白名单要你自己维护，没配就等于全放行或全拦。
limit_en: Covers only inbound-triggered actions, not sending, templates or deliverability. You maintain the allowlist; unset means allow-all or block-all.
title_en: Turn inbound email into agent actions, safely
